dogecoin.text: @RetirementRight Had a friend tell me about their experience with a co-worker saying that people got their dogecoin liquidated and thought that meant they pulled their money out... sad times.

@farrisbaba “If robinhood was the match and bitcoin was the kerosine soaked rags then Dogecoin was the atomic bomb with the drunk president holding his finger over the button. It was at this moment bears knew the whole world economy might collapse.”
